summaries.summary: The Printers class is a comprehensive iOS Smart app page object that extends SmartFlow and provides extensive automation support for printer discovery, connection, and setup workflows. Key patterns include: (1) Extensive use of wait_for_object with configurable timeouts and raise_e parameters for flexible element verification; (2) Platform-specific handling (iOS vs MAC) for UI interactions like swipe gestures and button clicks; (3) Retry logic for flaky operations such as MOOBE printer selection with configurable attempt counts; (4) Bidirectional scrolling (up and down) for finding printers in long lists; (5) Multiple printer connection methods including WiFi, Ethernet, IP address, serial number, and Bluetooth; (6) Comprehensive UI validation methods that check multiple screen elements; (7) Exception handling with TimeoutException and NoSuchElementException for robust test execution; (8) Sleep delays for synchronization after certain operations; (9) Dynamic element locators using format_specifier for printer-specific elements; (10) GA (Google Analytics) tracking integration for counting printers; (11) Support for empty state screens, error states (WiFi off), and permission blockers; (12) Multi-step workflows like add_printer_ip that chain multiple operations; (13) Conditional logic for handling optional popups and platform differences; (14) Text extraction and validation methods for search bars and printer names; (15) Index-based and name-based printer selection strategies. The class demonstrates enterprise-grade test automation with extensive error handling, logging, and flexible verification options suitable for complex mobile UI testing scenarios.
